title: Normal rings descend along faithfully flat ring maps
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a faithfully flat homomorphism of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map]. If $S$ is a normal ring, then $R$ is a normal ring [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]; explicitly, if every prime localization $S_{\mathfrak q}$ is an integrally closed domain, then every prime localization $R_{\mathfrak p}$ is an integrally closed domain. No Noetherian, domain, finite-type or locality hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 033G (lemma-descent-normal), full statement; proof localizes to a faithfully flat local map and descends membership in principal ideals.
